sync_step1_hint: Make sure you are logged in to your account.
sync_step2_guide:
1. Press F12  (or right-click → Inspect)
2. Click the Application tab at the top
3. In the left panel open:  Storage → Cookies → https://www.crunchyroll.com
4. Find the cookie named  etp_rt  and double-click its Value column
5. Copy the full value (it is a long string)
sync_cookie_help:
How to get the cookie:
  1. Log in to crunchyroll.com
  2. Open DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → https://www.crunchyroll.com
  3. Copy the value of the 'etp_rt' cookie

schedule_desc:
Automatically sync your Crunchyroll history and export it every day at a set time.
Requires the etp_rt cookie and at least one export target configured in Settings.

schedule_note_unix: Uses crontab. The task runs silently in the background.
